name: memory_store
description:
Store a new verified problem-resolution episode into shared memory.

    :param symptom: Error signature, exception message, or symptom description.
    :param root_cause: Explanation of the underlying defect.
    :param resolution: Summary or description of how the bug was fixed.
    :param code_diff: Unified diff or patch snippet implementing the fix.
    :param metadata: Optional dictionary of additional context metadata.
    :return: Dict containing memory_id and storage status.
